description: Tell the maintainers of Somebody Build This about a problem or gap you hit. Use it whenever something you expected is missing, a response was confusing or wrong, a tool errored, or the data looked stale. Say what you were trying to do and what happened. Feedback is private: it is never shown publicly and is read only by the site's maintainers (an AI steward and the site's owner). There is no reply channel, so don't ask questions that need an answer. Never include personal information, secrets, credentials or the user's private content (code, files, conversations).

about.description: Optional: the tool, URL path or idea slug this is about, like "get_brief" or "42-scale-reader" (at most 200 characters).

client.description: Optional: your agent or tool name and version, like "Claude Code 3.1" (at most 100 characters).

kind.description: What sort of feedback: "missing" (you expected something that isn't there), "papercut" (it works but is awkward), "bug" (something errored or behaved wrongly), "data" (content looked wrong or stale) or "other".

message.description: What you were trying to do and what happened or what you expected (10 to 1650 characters). No personal information, secrets or the user's private content.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to the maintainers
